about_the_game:
Demo Version Overview

This demo offers approximately 2–3 hours of gameplay:

You’ll control Vyke, the goblin protagonist, as he explores the first major area — The Cathedral of the Nameless God. Along the way, you can unlock up to 7 unique NPC storylines, learn multiple active skills, and combine them with powerful charms to create a thieving style that suits you.

This version also features the employee system and order management mechanics. You’ll need to wisely allocate your earnings to prepare for debt collectors, who come knocking every four days.

Game Overview

Goblin Vyke is a 2D side-scrolling game that blends stealth thievery with shop management. You play as Vyke, a cunning goblin who lives a double life:

At night, he’s a thief sneaking into dungeons to steal valuable goods.
By day, he’s a shrewd merchant, selling those stolen goods at inflated prices for maximum profit.

Master the art of stealth, evade deadly traps, and plunder treasures from demon lords. Recruit employees, expand your chain of shops, and grow your business empire. Rise from a penniless goblin to a powerful black-market tycoon!

Night: Steal in the Shadows

As a small and fragile goblin, direct combat isn’t an option. But you can outsmart your enemies — use skills and the environment to sneak in, grab valuables, and vanish without a trace.

Day: Sell High, Profit More

To get rich, you’ll need to manipulate prices — use bragging and haggle skills to raise the customer’s Persuasion Value. If you hit the sweet spot, they’ll pay extra willingly. But when you push too far, they’ll walk away.

From Penniless to Powerful

You start the story deep in debt, just another broke goblin. But as your thieving skills sharpen and your business booms, powerful factions begin to take notice. Some want your favor, some your help — even the Demon Lord of the Golden Dungeon sees potential in you... and wants you to become her next representative.
